title: Next steps after setup (ship-fleet doctor --next --json, version 1)
description: What is left to do on a FleetLedger computer after first-run setup stops at the first Ship, one step per entry, always in the same order with every key present. Produced by FleetLedger (fleetledger/fleetledger/nextsteps.py) from doctor's own checks, read offline: it contacts no Ship, Proxmox or Tailscale. Consumed by programs that draw it, such as a Herdr Fleet panel. A command is text to show or run in a terminal; a program must not add --yes or answer its questions.

left.description: How many steps are todo, attention or blocked.

left_required.description: How many of those are not optional.

key.description: setup: FleetLedger's own setup (what ship-fleet doctor checks). first-ship: a Ship made and enrolled. signins: one Ship with every sign-in it uses (from its last saved status). this-computer: this computer trusted to attach (plain ssh, hc). other-devices: the web UI reachable from other devices (ship-fleet ui remote). laptop: another computer trusted. always-on: the fleetledger service, or FleetLedger's own VM. vault: FleetLedger's vault on and unlocked. backups: a backup made (they need the vault).

state.description: done: nothing to do. todo: not done yet; command does it. attention: set up but needs fixing; command fixes it. blocked: waits for the step named by after. skip: not needed on this computer.

detail.description: One line on where it stands.

command.description: For todo and attention: the command (or step) that does or fixes it, with any NAME, DIR or LOGIN for the user to fill in. Empty otherwise.

docs.description: A page in the ShipShape checkout that explains it.

after.description: For blocked: the key of the step it waits for. Empty otherwise.
